enchantments.tooltip: Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Dexterity +13: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Intelligence +13: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Wisdom +13: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Doubleshot 8%: Passive: 8% Enhancement bonus to Doubleshot. (Doubleshot is a chance to score an additional hit with a ranged attack.)
Insightful Deception +5: +5 Insight bonus to hit and +8 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Quality Deception +2: +2 Quality bonus to hit and +3 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
